Karnataka Tourism Road Show, 2023 happened in three cities in the month of August. In which one of the following s was it organised? 1. Pune 2. Goa 3. Mumbai 4. Ambedkar Development Corporation Limited? Ambedkar Development Corporation implements targeted economic and educational support for eligible beneficiaries. · Future angle: corporation → scheme → beneficiary. 23. With reference to Karnataka Raitha Samruddhi Yojana, which of the following statements are correct? t aims to double the productivity and triple the farmers' income by 2029-30. Which of the following are the major irrigation projects located in Krishna basin? Bennithora (b) Hipparagi (c) Markandeya (d) Bhadra 1. (a), (b) and (c) only 2. (b) and (c) only 3. KEONICS is a state technology institution used for IT infrastructure and allied capacity-building services. · Future questions may ask KEONICS, KAVERI, Bhoomi or e-governance platforms. 28. Which of the following statements are correct? European Investment Bank and JICA are providing financial aid for ongoing Bengaluru suburban rail project. (b) 'Police Mitra' chat box recently launched by Karnataka Police uses ChatGPT technology to facilitate answering queries related to cybercrime, traffic etc. (c) On the occasion of launch of Yuva Nidhi Scheme, Freedom Park in Shivamogga was renamed as Allama Prabhu Park. (b), (c) and (d) only 3. (c) and (d) only 4. All of the above A Karnataka infrastructure + policing technology current-affairs question. Treat each statement separately: financing agencies for suburban rail and the Police Mitra digital initiative are distinct facts. Bengaluru suburban rail is a major urban-transport project involving external financing; Police Mitra reflects digital citizen-police engagement. · Future angle: project → financier → corridor; portal → department → purpose. 29. Consider the following statements about e-greenwatch portal: Created to manage the works using CAMPA funds and monitor progress of plantations raised in CA lands. (b) Launched by Government of Karnataka in compliance with the orders of the High Court of Karnataka. (c) The portal is jointly monitored by the MoEF & CC and the Forest Survey of India. (d) It enables user agencies to register themselves and apply for forest land diversion proposal under Forest Conservation Act, 1980. Which of the above statements is/are correct? 1. (a) and (b) only 2. (b) and (d) only 3. (a) and (c) only 4. (b), (c) and (d) only A forest-governance and CAMPA technology question. Recognise e-GreenWatch as a monitoring platform for CAMPA-related works and compensatory-afforestation activities; check the launch/agency statement carefully. e-GreenWatch improves transparency and monitoring of afforestation and CAMPA expenditure. · Future questions may ask CAMPA, compensatory afforestation and monitoring portals. 30. India's nomination of The Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas has been inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage list in the oing extended 45th World Heritage Committee Meeting being held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. India submitted the nomination dossier for The Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas to the World Heritage Centre in January, 2022. The site has been on UNESCO's tentative list since 2014. (a) This is the 42nd UNESCO World Heritage Site of India. (b) It includes 3 temples - Hoysaleshvara Temple, Halebidu, Chennakeshava Temple, Belur and Keshava Temple, Somanathpura in Karnataka. (c) This addition makes Karnataka the State with highest number of UNESCO's World Heritage sites in India. (d) These temples were built between 5th-8th century AD by Hoysalas. Which of the above statements are correct? 1. (a) and (d) only 2. (b), (c) and (d) only 3. (a) and (b) only 4. The Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas represent the Hoysala architectural tradition and its temple complexes. · Which Hoysala sites are included? → Belur, Halebidu, Somnathapura · Future questions may ask dynasty, architecture and UNESCO year. 31. Consider the following statements about Women's Premier League: WPL is owned and operated by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). (b) The final for 2024 season was played in Arun Jaitley Cricket Stadium, New Delhi. (c) Total number of teams participating in the tournament is 6. (d) The official mascot of the WPL is named 'Shakti' and resembles a tigress, donning a blue jersey. How many statements is/are correct? 1. Only 1 statement is correct 2. Only 2 statements are correct 3. Only 3 statements are correct 4. All the 4 statements are correct A sports-current-affairs statement question on the Women’s Premier League. Check ownership/operation, venue and season facts separately; sports questions often contain one altered venue or date. WPL is India’s premier women’s franchise cricket league operated under BCCI oversight. · Future angle: inaugural season, champion, venue and governing body. 32. Consider the following statements about Kari Ishad, which is accepted as one of the finest quality mangoes due to its ue aroma, luscious taste, high amount of pulp, shape and size: (a) Kari Ishad mango is prominently grown in Ankola taluk of Uttara Kannada. (d) There are total three variants of Ishad mango. How many statements is/are correct? 1. Only 1 statement is correct 2. Only 2 statements are correct 3. Only 3 statements are correct 4. All the 4 statements are correct A Karnataka agriculture/geographical-indication-style question on Kari Ishad mango. Identify the geographical association first and then check the cultivation, quality and location statements. Kari Ishad is a premium mango associated with coastal Karnataka, especially the Uttara Kannada region. · Future questions may ask GI-tagged Karnataka products and their districts. 33. Consider the following statements about High Court of Karnataka: Appointment of the Chief Justice is made by the Governor in consultation with the Chief Justice of India (CJI) and the Chief Minister of the State. (b) The Court's principal bench is located in Bengaluru, with three additional benches in Mangaluru, Hubballi-Dharwada and Kalaburagi. Only 2 statements are correct 3. Only 3 statements are correct 4. All 4 statements are correct A constitutional/legal statement question on the High Court of Karnataka. Remember that High Court judges are appointed by the President under Article 217; state executive consultation is not the same as the appointment authority. High Court appointment, transfer and jurisdiction are constitutional subjects; the President formally appoints judges after the prescribed consultation process. · Future angle: Article 214, 217, 222 and High Court jurisdiction. 34. Which of the following statements is correct about the Asha Kirana Initiative? 1. It is an initiative for door-to-door eye screening. 2. It is revolutionary drive to promote menstrual cups (M-cups) among women. 3. It is an initiative to promote millets. 4. It is an initiative to deliver ration to 80+ aged citizens. A Karnataka public-health initiative question. Identify Asha Kirana by its service model: door-to-door eye screening and referral/vision-care support. Asha Kirana illustrates community-based preventive eye-care delivery. · Future questions may ask target population, department and service pathway. 35. Consider the following statements about Pampa Awards: t is the highest literary honour conferred by the Department of Kannada and Culture to recognise works written in the Kannada language. All 4 statements are correct A Karnataka literary-award current-affairs question. Separate the award’s institution, status and named personalities; award questions are best solved through association chains. The Pampa Award is a major Kannada literary honour associated with the Department of Kannada and Culture. · Future angle: Pampa Award → recipient → work; Kannada literary awards → institution. 36. What is the name of the project in Karnataka aimed at diverting water from the west-flowing rivers to the er-deficient regions, facing opposition from environmentalists and neighbouring States? 1. Tungabhadra Water Transfer Initiative A Karnataka inter-basin water-transfer project question. Inter-basin transfers in Karnataka involve water-sharing, ecology, interstate disputes and tribunal decisions. · Future questions may ask river, tributaries, tribunal and beneficiary districts. 37. Neither (a) nor (b) A Karnataka rural-road infrastructure scheme question. Use the two quantitative clues—target road length and proposed expenditure/coverage—to identify the correct statement combination. Pragati Path is a rural connectivity initiative; infrastructure schemes are often tested through scale, target and funding. · Future angle: Pragati Path → road length → rural connectivity. 38. On the lines of the Mumbai-Chennai economic corridor, the Karnataka Government has planned similar corridors een: (a) The New Mangalore Port and Bengaluru. (b) Hubballi-Dharwad and Bengaluru. Only (a) and (c) A Karnataka economic-corridor planning question. Identify the corridor endpoints and compare them with the model of an industrial/economic corridor linking a port to Bengaluru. Economic corridors integrate ports, logistics, manufacturing clusters and major urban markets. · Future questions may ask corridor → port → city → sector. 39. Following are the pillars of Karnataka's Startup Policy 2022-27: Creating and strengthening New Age Innovation Network. (b) Channelizing innovation for Societal Impact. (c) Fostering Social and Rural Entrepreneurship. (d) Building inclusive and equitable Startup Ecosystem. Which of the above statements are the pillars of Karnataka's Start-up Policy 2022-27? Choose the correct answer from the options given below: 1. (a), (b) and (c) only 2. (b), (c) and (d) only 3. (a), (c) and (d) only 4. All of the above A Karnataka Startup Policy 2022–27 statement question. Treat each pillar as a policy objective; New Age Innovation Network, societal impact and social/rural entrepreneurship are core themes. The policy seeks to strengthen innovation ecosystems, inclusive entrepreneurship and startup support across Karnataka. · Future angle: startup policy → pillars → incubators → funding mechanisms. 40. Read the statements as programme-design facts: city selection, renewable-energy targets and funding arrangements must be distinguished. The Solar City programme aims to increase renewable-energy use and reduce conventional-energy dependence at the urban level. · Future questions may ask target cities, renewable share and implementing agencies. 41. AVGC-XR is a creative-technology sector covering animation, visual effects, gaming, comics and extended-reality ecosystems. · Future angle: policy period, incentives, jobs and AVGC clusters. 42. Stamp legislation governs duties on specified instruments and transactions; amendment questions require precise statutory recall. · Future questions may ask instrument-wise stamp duty and amendment year. 43. Which of the following statements are incorrect about the State Finance Commission? The State Finance Commission deals with Panchayats and municipalities. Article 243-I provides for a State Finance Commission to review local-body finances and recommend devolution. · Future angle: State Finance Commission vs Finance Commission of India. 44. Which of the following statements are correct? KaBHI; Karnataka Brain Health Initiative is an initiative launched by the Karnataka's Health Department. (b) It aims at establishing 33 brain clinics which will help people in dealing with psychological diseases and disorders. All of the above A Karnataka health-innovation current-affairs question on the Brain Health Initiative. Match the initiative with its clinics, screening and public-health objectives; avoid confusing it with a tertiary-care-only programme. Karnataka Brain Health Initiative seeks early detection and decentralised management of neurological/brain-health conditions. · Future angle: brain clinics → screening → referral → public-health system. 45. Consider the following statements: The Karnataka Government recently permitted a maximum of six months (180 days) of parental leave only. (b) It is applicable to both Government and private male employees. (c) Single male parent does not include divorcees. Parental-leave policy questions combine labour/service rules with gender and family-support provisions. · Future questions may compare maternity, paternity and parental leave. 46. Which of the following statements are correct about The Factories (Karnataka Amendment) Act, 2023? The Amendment allows the factories to increase the working hours from nine hours up to twelve hours exclusive of rest intervals. (b) The overtime can be extended to a maximum of 48 hours in any week. (d) The State Government may by notification, extend the total number of hours of work of a worker without an interval to six hours in respect of any group or class or description of factories on such conditions as it may deem expedient. 1. (b) and (d) only 2. (a) and (c) only 3. (a) and (b) only 4. (a) and (d) only A labour-law amendment question on factory working hours. Separate the statutory ceiling, overtime provisions and rest intervals. Statement combinations often alter one number. Factory-law amendments must be read with working-hour limits, overtime and worker-safety provisions. · Future angle: Factories Act → working hours → overtime → safety. 47. Which of the following statements are correct? The Government of Karnataka has been a leader in promotion of millets - The first Organics and Millets Fair was held in 2017, the second and third editions in 2018 and 2024 in Bengaluru. Only one statement is correct 2. Only two statements are correct 3. All of the above statements are correct 4. None of the above statements are correct A Karnataka agriculture/current-affairs question on millet promotion. Use the chronology of the Organics and Millets Fair and Karnataka’s millet-promotion initiatives to validate the statements. Karnataka has been an important promoter of millets, organic farming and value-added millet products. · Future angle: millet species → nutritional value → Karnataka fairs/policy. 48. What is the DISHANK app launched by the Karnataka Government primarily designed for? 1. To identify land survey number and location 2. For preserving and conserving wildlife 3. For disaster management 4. To identify drought hit areas A Karnataka land-record technology question. DISHANK is a geospatial land-information app; connect it with survey number, location and parcel identification. DISHANK helps users locate and identify land parcels through survey-related geospatial information. · Future questions may compare DISHANK, Bhoomi and Mojini. 49. How many of the following statements are incorrect about e-sahamathi? t is a portal wherein the data holder gives consent to share his/her data with other agencies. (b) It has been developed by e-Governance department with National Informatics Centre (NIC). (c) Government will be custodian of the data, i e. Data Fiduciary and can sell this data to private agencies and earn revenue on the same. (d) Karnataka will be the first State in the country which is monetizing the data. 1. Only one statement is wrong 2. Only two statements are wrong 3. All of the above statements are wrong 4. None of the above statements are wrong A Karnataka data-governance consent-platform question. Identify which statements describe consent-based data sharing, the development agency and the portal’s function; count the incorrect statements carefully. e-Sahamathi is a consent-oriented data-sharing framework in Karnataka’s digital-governance ecosystem. · Future angle: consent → data principal → data holder → digital governance. 50. Which of the following statements are correct about Lion-Tailed Macaque? As per the study conducted by the Karnataka Forest Department and Coimbatore-based Salim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History (SACON), Karnataka has the world's largest population of Lion-Tailed Macaques (LTMs). Consider the following statements: Uttar Pradesh and Karnataka dominated the electronics export amongst other Indian States till 2022. (b) In the last five financial years, Karnataka has shown consistent growth in electronics export. (c) Tamil Nadu has the highest export (in value INR) of electronic goods for the year 2023-24. How many statements is/are correct? 1. Only 1 statement is correct 2. Only 2 statements are correct 3. Only 3 statements are correct 4. All statements are incorrect A Karnataka electronics-export/current-affairs statement question. Compare the state-level export trend and the specific growth claim; avoid treating a national ranking as a Karnataka-only fact. Karnataka is a major Indian electronics and technology-export hub, with Bengaluru as a key ecosystem. · Future angle: electronics exports → states → Bengaluru cluster. 52. Consider the following statements: Karnataka has established a “Fact check unit” to combat fake news and misinformation, especially on social media. Distinguish a fact-checking unit from an information-disorder tackling unit and verify which statements describe each correctly. For which of the following Kannada poetries, Shruthi B. R. has received the 2024 Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar? 1. Dhoopada Makkalu 2. Zero Balance 3. Phoo Mattu Ithara Kathegalu 4. Togala Cheelada Karna A Karnataka literary-current-affairs question on the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar. Identify the awardee and then the work; literary awards are often tested as person–work pairs. Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar recognises young writers in Indian languages, including Kannada. · Future angle: award → language → work → year. 54. The NITI Aayog has identified Raichur and Yadgiri Districts of Karnataka as Aspirational districts in which of the following es? Match Raichur and Yadgiri with the specific theme category used by the Aspirational Districts framework.
